source.title: Midnight Enchanting Guide: Recipes & Knowledge Points — Glimmering Powder catch-up and drop rates

quote: After getting all your Weekly Knowledge Points, you'll start looting Glimmering Powder.
notes: Source attributes the catch-up drop to weekly completions and being behind on maximum Enchanting Knowledge. Specific eligible gear item IDs, rarity exclusions, gear slot and item-level eligibility not enumerated; Wowhead item 267653 identity independently checked. The weekly knowledge prerequisite is NOT a Disenchanting Delegate skill/spec requirement.
inputName: Eligible Midnight gear (specific item IDs/slots unspecified)
requires: Catch-up state: complete Enchanting trainer weekly quest, collect the 5 Swirling Arcane Essence and 1 Brimming Mana Shard weekly disenchant KP items, collect both weekly treasure KP items (Lost Thalassian Vellum and Voidstorm Ashes), and remain below the available Enchanting Knowledge catch-up cap.

source.title: Midnight Enchanting Guide: Recipes & Knowledge Points — Glimmering Powder catch-up and drop rates

notes: Original guide author reports only a few hundred aggregate disenchanting attempts with no exact rarity-specific denominators, hit counts, output quantities by category, zero bins, character skill/spec, build, gear slot or item level. Approximate author-reported percentage (tilde in source), not a precise measured rate. Applies to Glimmering Powder 267653 after weekly prerequisites, not to Eversinging Dust, Radiant Shard or Dawn Crystal. Reference-only; MUST NOT synthesize sample counts, confidence or baseline probability.
